Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The Dataset Nutrition Label: A Framework To Drive Higher Data Quality Standards (1805.03677v1) · paper method: The paper warns that the validity of a ground-truth comparison module depends on its reference dataset and can be harmed by a flawed comparator.

Permanent record ID: cohort8.claim.nutrition.comparator-limits

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Labels for comparator datasets and community feedback are suggested mitigations, not proof that bias has been eliminated.
